description: Work out the most a landlord or agent can ask for as a tenancy deposit and a holding deposit, from the rent, in any UK nation, and optionally check a deposit the user was asked for. England limits both; Wales limits the holding deposit; Scotland and Northern Ireland limit the tenancy deposit.

depositAsked.description: The tenancy deposit the landlord or agent asked for, in pounds, if the user gave one.

nation.description: The UK nation the home is in.

rent.description: The rent for one rent period, in pounds, for example 1200 or 950.50.

rentPeriod.description: How often the rent falls due.

name: check_deposit_cap
title: Deposit cap check
